1651-2499-6754-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.

Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.

Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.

116-512-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.

116-512-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1263-3967-4871-4976.description:

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1323-4762-7741.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-4762-7741.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1

Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.

Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

11-3617-6555-7089.description:

Holding priority, cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Walk.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Walk spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Walk spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Walk and returning the original Time Walk to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Walk from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2921-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
2921-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.

Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.

You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5414-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Saproling's power.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

Cast Mischievous Pup by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Mischievous Pup enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mirror Image from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Evangel of Heliod token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.

Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Phylath token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Resolve the Aether Flash trigger, dealing 2 damage to Soul Collector.
Soul Collector dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
Soul Collector triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Éomer cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You have at least three opponents.

At the beginning of combat, Duke Ulder Ravengard triggers, giving Éomer an additional instance of myriad until end of turn.
Declare Éomer as an attacker.
Each instance of Éomer's myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Éomer token(s) die, each Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get at least two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
Once you have an arbitrarily high number of combat phases, you may have Duke Ulder Ravengard give myriad to any other creatures you control.
3951-4989.notes: The combo stops once you have two or fewer opponents. The combo will make progressively more combat phases, but you cannot untap creatures in between using the cards in this combo.
